title: PLTR-AIE: controls that hold when the model misbehaves

layers.name: Prompt
items: A layer that does not enforce anything

layers.name: Tools and Actions
items: Never give the agent a tool it must not use

layers.name: Retrieval
items: Permission and approval filters before ranking

layers.name: Action validation
items: Kept even when the function already checks values

caption: Only the top band lives in the prompt; when a requirement says "must never", the answer sits in one of the bands below it.
alt: Six control layers: prompt, tools and Actions, retrieval as the user, Action validation, human approval, platform restrictions.
